examples.description: Place a music track under the video from the start

description: Place an audio asset on a role track: 'audio-music' (background, default volume 0.3 — voice ducks music by role) or 'audio-voice' (narration, volume 1.0). It lands on the role's first track, or on the one track_id names (a second music bed, a second voice).

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

track_id.description: An audio track (vtr_) from get_composition; its role wins when track is left out. Defaults to the role's first track.
